display_name: Bosch EDC16C41 Nissan Patrol GU V Wagon (23710-VS43B / ZD30CRD variants)
vehicles: Nissan Patrol GU V Wagon 3.0 TDI / ZD30CRD

flash_memory_map.full_flash: ~2 MB total (approx 1 MB flash + 2 KB EEPROM for adaptations/immobiliser)
flash_memory_map.calibration_region: Separate working calibration file available in reference

checksum.description: Multiple checksum regions across flash. After map changes (IQ, boost, timing, EGR etc.) recalculate and patch correction values so all regions validate. Reference working flash files for testing. No native Rust implementation yet - add in future (similar to P01 checksum.rs).
checksum.notes: WinOLS or manual mapping typically used for checksum locations. Port public EDC16 correction logic when implementing full support.

security_access.reference: Code for Device.md + planned edc16_seedkey.rs (similar to security.rs for P01)

maps_and_xdf.description: No ready XDF in reference. Requires WinOLS export or manual reverse engineering of diesel maps from the working bin. Key maps: Driver Wish (torque request map), Injection Quantity (IQ) vs speed/torque, Boost setpoint, Rail pressure, VGT duty, EGR maps, Smoke limit, Timing.
maps_and_xdf.eeprom: EDC16C41 working eeprom (2 KB) - immobiliser, adaptations, coding data

notes: Matches and expands the REFERENCE_INDEX.md entry. 23710-VS43B is the specific hardware/part for GU V Wagon variant. DB entry enables auto-identification. Rust support added: CAN (ELM/ISO-TP), KWP2000, Nissan Consult II for live data + commands. Use protocol selector in UI. Full UDS flash sequence and Bosch checksum porting in progress for guided pipeline on this ECU.
